divergences.found: nameKey only lower-cases (src/storage/archive.ts:99-101 of the file, name rule of phase 1). A name that differs from an existing file only by Unicode normalization (NFC against NFD) is not found in `inFolder`. Then writeToFolder calls getFileHandle(name, { create: true }). On a file system that treats these names as one name, this can open the existing file and write over it. This verifier did not reproduce it: the test machine has no such file system. The plan asks only for case, so this is recorded as a limit of the plan, not a defect against it.
